create_perturbed_attention_guidance: create a PerturbedAttentionGuidance guider with custom guidance scale and perturbed guidance layers
build_perturbed_attention_guidance: build a PerturbedAttentionGuidance instance with LayerSkipConfig for selective layer perturbation
